ios-navigation|Searching.summary: Plenix search results on iOS keep the system’s search (the searchable modifier or UISearchController, its scope bar and keyboard) and draw each result as a Plenix row: what it is (a page’s icon in a thumbnail, a file’s picture, a person’s avatar), the name with the words searched for in bold, the path above it, a line around the match and its details, the technical values in DM Mono. Results of several kinds sit in sections headed by the kind and its count, each with a row that shows all of that kind.

variants.name: Page (default)
variants.apple: A List row in the search results
variants.swiftui: List row: Label(title, systemImage:) with the Plenix thumbnail, the snippet and the meta
variants.uikit: UICollectionViewListCell with a Plenix content configuration
variants.appkit: NSTableCellView with the Plenix row (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Notes, pages, projects and other records.

variants.name: File
variants.apple: A List row with a thumbnail
variants.swiftui: The same row with the file’s QuickLook thumbnail and its size and date in DM Mono
variants.appkit: QLThumbnailGenerator in the cell (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

variants.name: Person

variants.swiftui: The row with the Plenix avatar (a rounded square with initials)

variants.appkit: The cell with the avatar view (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

variants.name: Grouped by kind

variants.use: A search across pages, files and people.

anatomy.name: Thumbnail or avatar
anatomy.about: What the result is: a page’s icon on the sunken surface, a file’s picture, a person’s avatar.

anatomy.name: Path
anatomy.about: Where the result sits, from the top, with chevrons between the places, in secondary text.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.about: The result’s name; the words searched for are bold, never colored.

anatomy.name: Snippet and details
anatomy.about: Two lines at most around the match, then the type, size and date (technical values in DM Mono).

anatomy.name: Section header
anatomy.about: The kind in the plural and its count, when results of several kinds are shown.

attributes.value: Default content color, DM Sans medium at the Body role

attributes.apple: None (Apple leaves highlighting to the app)
attributes.uikit: NSAttributedString with a bold DM Sans font on each match range
attributes.appkit: NSAttributedString with a bold font on each match (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.value: Muted content color at the Secondary role
attributes.appkit: secondary field textColor = Plenix.Colors.contentMuted (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.value: Subtle content color; sizes and dates in the data font (DM Mono)

attributes.value: The inline medium space between the thumbnail and the text
